The main takeaway from our work is that
the risk for retinal detachment after LASIK in eyes with moderate and high myopia is not insignificant.

the retinal breaks in eyes that undergo LASIK are often large, multiple, and posterior to the equatar and that the retinal detachments are complex in terms of the number, size and location of the retinal breaks.
